verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships official SDKs for JS/browser/Node/React Native with automatic uncaught error detection and framework plugins, plus explicit claims of over 50 platform libraries covering frontend, backend, and mobile, with hands-on community praise for easy setup and automatic fatal error reporting on iOS. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically for backend/server SDKs and deeper mobile platform detail, and no explicit mention of automatic crash capture for native Android alongside iOS/React Native.
